notice: RN bank batch 135: Maternity case studies: placental abruption, placenta previa, gestational diabetes and Rh incompatibility. questions.stem: Highlight the 30-minute findings that require immediate action.

questions.stem: After the birth, the newborn is stable in the NICU. Which actions about the cocaine use are appropriate? Select all that apply.

options.text: Follow hospital policy and state law on reporting prenatal substance exposure
Offer a referral to substance use treatment
Use nonjudgmental language when discussing it
Tell the client the baby will be taken away

exhibits.title: Orders
exhibits.body: Admit until birth. Planned cesarean hysterectomy at 34 to 35 weeks with a specialized team.

questions.stem: The obstetrician explains a planned cesarean hysterectomy. Afterward, the client says, "I didn't understand. Will I still be able to have more children?" Which actions should the nurse take? Select all that apply.

options.text: Tell the obstetrician the client needs more explanation before signing
Arrange an interpreter or support person if needed
Hold the consent form until questions are answered
Explain the surgery in detail and have the client sign
Tell the client the doctor knows best

rationale.correct: The surgeon must re-explain; consent must be informed.

perOption.d: Explaining the procedure is the surgeon's role.

references: NCSBN National Guidelines for Nursing Delegation; LaCharity, Prioritization, Delegation & Assignment

questions.stem: Which actions about Rho(D) immune globulin are correct? Select all that apply.

options.text: Give it IM in the deltoid
Confirm the client's blood type and negative antibody screen
Dose by the size of the fetal bleed if large

rationale.correct: IM to the unsensitized mother, dosed by bleed size.

perOption.d: It is given to the mother.

exhibits.title: Orders
exhibits.body: Rho(D) immune globulin 300 mcg IM now. Repeat at birth if the baby is Rh positive.

questions.stem: At birth, the baby is A positive. Which actions should the nurse take? Select all that apply.

options.text: Send cord blood for type and Coombs
Skip it because the client had it at 30 weeks
Wait until the 6-week postpartum visit to give it

rationale.correct: Cord blood tests and a dose within 72 hours.

exhibits.title: Birth, 39 weeks

questions.stem: At discharge, for each statement, indicate whether it shows understanding or needs more teaching.

"The shot protects my next babies, not me."
"Now that I've had it, I'm protected forever."
"I'll tell any provider that I'm Rh negative."

rationale.correct: Repeat with each exposure; given to the mother.

perOption.r3:c1: Each exposure needs a new dose.
perOption.r3:c2: Each exposure needs a new dose.

testSets.title: NCLEX-RN adaptive exam
testSets.description: Works like the real NCLEX-RN: each question depends on your answers so far, and the exam stops once your result is clear, after 85 to 150 questions. Choose timed (5 hours) or untimed. No going back; answers and rationales at the end. The questions are being rewritten to real NCLEX difficulty and recalibrated, so treat your result as a practice estimate.
